human_annotation_sources.name: Amazon Mechanical Turk
human_annotation_sources.notes: MTurk requester pricing is public, but worker reward is requester-selected. This scenario models a low-cost single-rater short text-classification task.

human_annotation_sources.name: Prolific
human_annotation_sources.notes: Base scenario uses Prolific recommended participant pay for a short single-rater text-classification task.

human_annotation_sources.name: Prolific
human_annotation_sources.notes: High scenario models slower examples, higher participant pay, and two independent labels.

llm_api_sources.name: OpenAI API pricing
llm_api_sources.unit: USD per 1M input and output tokens
llm_api_sources.notes: Keep model prices in experiment metadata when running API-backed annotation. The repository can estimate token-based costs without storing an API key.

excluded_primary_sources.name: Managed annotation vendors
excluded_primary_sources.reason: Many managed services use quote-based pricing, so they are documented qualitatively unless a dated quote is available.
